_purpose: Maps every chord shape to the lesson that FIRST teaches it, derived from 07-app/content/lessons/manifest.json order. Mystery Mode is an OPT-IN ADVANCED mode for students already in the program (owner directive 2026-08-14), so a mystery song may only unlock once the student has been taught EVERY chord it uses. tools/verify-song-progressions.js RE-DERIVES this in-process and fails if this file disagrees.
